# Bizcraw

> Bizcraw is a web scraping and AI sales workspace that helps teams collect public business data, review structured results, move approved records into CRM workflows, and manage the sales work that follows.

## Canonical overview

- [What is Bizcraw?](https://bizcraw.com/what-is-bizcraw): Product definition, audience, workflow, and controls.
- [Features](https://bizcraw.com/features): Product capabilities.
- [Solutions](https://bizcraw.com/solutions): Use cases for web scraping, lead generation, and CRM activation.
- [Pricing](https://bizcraw.com/pricing): Current public plans and included capabilities.
- [MCP server](https://bizcraw.com/mcp): How compatible AI clients connect to Bizcraw.
